scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.start:backend: cd backend && arch -arm64 venv/bin/python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.test: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run test:backend" "npm run test:frontend"
